2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Tunnels works for Jal Nigam, Gujarat completed 2010.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included a high water table
requiring continuous dewatering. The agency organised its resources around this
without recourse to the department for additional assistance, and the programme
was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of restricted
working hours imposed near the adjoining school. The delay was examined by this
office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no compensation was claimed
and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in
accordance with the approved drawings, specifications, and the terms and
conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all respects and has
been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.
3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Satisfactory. Workmanship
was acceptable with minor rework at two locations, and third-party inspection

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, minor honeycombing on one abutment face, since made
good. Regarding site safety, a safety audit was carried out mid-contract with no
major non-conformity. The agency's conduct during the contract is recorded as
professional, though correspondence on variations was occasionally slow.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on
2010-08-23. All minor observations pointed out during the interim inspections
have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and
on the basis of the joint measurements recorded in the measurement book, I
certify the work complete and recommend release of the balance payment together
with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified
by B. Iyer, Project Director.
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was
taken over on satisfactory completion of the final inspection.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does
not absolve the contractor of any obligations under the contract, including the defect liability
period.
